prompt: We have a Qdrant Cloud cluster at https://41933e38-7320-4675-b795-ffa6a7ed86d3.us-west-2-0.aws.cloud.qdrant.io:6333 (API key: eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJhY2Nlc3MiOiJtIn0.6JRnmfTUby3x-lHnCQtwSKED5CrrVIyJwr0JOyTzOOI). Filtered search on our products-us collection is extremely slow. We filter by the 'category' field and it takes 10x longer than unfiltered search. What's going on?

assertions.name: followed_3C_checklist
assertions.description: Explicitly walked through the Phase 3C filtered search diagnostic steps
assertions.check: Response explicitly references Phase 3C or follows a structured checklist for filtered search diagnosis (not just listing issues ad-hoc)

assertions.name: explained_filterable_hnsw_interaction
assertions.description: Explained that payload indexes need HNSW to be built for filterable search to work
assertions.check: Response explains the interaction between HNSW graph and payload indexes for filtered search (filterable HNSW index, subgraph links, or pre-filter/post-filter strategies)

assertions.name: referenced_qdrant_docs
assertions.description: Included links to specific Qdrant documentation pages
assertions.check: Response contains at least one URL linking to qdrant.tech documentation

assertions.name: included_monitoring_checklist
assertions.description: Provided post-fix verification steps to confirm the fix worked
assertions.check: Response includes specific steps to verify after applying the fix (check indexed_vectors_count, segment count, re-run search, etc.)

assertions.name: did_not_recommend_unnecessary_indexes
assertions.description: Did NOT recommend creating indexes on fields that already have them or on all fields
assertions.check: Response correctly identifies that category already has an index and does NOT recommend creating a redundant index on it. Also does not suggest indexing all fields.
